_comment: The ratchet ceiling for scripts/check-claude-md.mjs. N = rules whose only control is model
N ABOVE this fails: mechanise the rule, or raise maxN in the same commit as the new rule and
argue it in the message. N BELOW this also fails: lower maxN to the new figure, because
tightening the ratchet is part of the mechanisation's acceptance, not a follow-up.
Exists because 'N may only fall' was printed and asserted as BINDING for a day while nothing
keyed on it — found by adversarial review, not by any check.
minD is the DENOMINATOR FLOOR, and it is what stops the N ceiling being gamed: markers
are required only inside `### Enforced` and §5, so cutting an UNENFORCEABLE bullet out of
§5 and pasting it into §8 as prose lowers N with the rule still in the file, still
unenforced, and now invisible. D falls with it, so that move fails here instead.
D may only RISE: a new enforced rule should be easy. Deleting a rule lowers minD in the
same commit, naming which rule and why.
